notes: Built only from the ICICI Coral Debit Card product page. Fees shown are before GST and are stated for new cards issued from 1 July 2026; older cards may have different fees. Reward point value (₹0.25) and no reward caps come from the cardholder. The page does not state excluded categories, insurance cover amounts, or which transaction limit is which. Those need the debit card T&C PDF.

sources.title: Cardholder's own information (Card Manager chat, 9 Oct 2026)
